title: MYTHOSEMANTIC: AN INTERACTIVE SYSTEM FOR DISCOVERING SEMANTIC PARALLELS ACROSS MYTHOLOGICAL AND RELIGIOUS TRADITIONS
reasoning: The paper explicitly introduces a system (MythoSemantic) for the computational comparative analysis of mythological and religious texts. It evaluates how well language models and embeddings group texts from various faith traditions, including Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, and others, making it highly relevant to the study of religion and spiritual traditions.
